title: OUTPUT: ~26s · 9:16 vertical · R2V · ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN SHOT. NO cuts, NO…
content:
OUTPUT: ~26s · 9:16 vertical · R2V · ONE SINGLE UNBROKEN SHOT. NO cuts, NO edits, NO transitions, NO black frames — the camera never stops moving. Hollywood disaster oner: the lens races, whips, dives, rises and orbits through the chaos in one flight. Two brief SPEED-RAMPS are the only time manipulation, and it still never cuts. NO music EVER — only fire, sirens, animal Foley and a wall of screaming Japanese voices.
STYLE: photorealistic live-action blockbuster cinema at NIGHT DURING WAR. Gimbal energy, real motion blur, embers and ash in every beam, anamorphic flare, deep blacks, ISO grain. Fire-orange key from burning buildings, cold blue emergency fill, red flare glow, searchlights sweeping the ground. NOT anime, NOT CG-cartoon, never cute. Every creature has real weight — fur, hide and muscle, wet with smoke grime.
LOCATION: Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo, at night in wartime. Half the LED billboards are shattered and shorting, the rest still flickering ads over the ruin. Buildings burn on two sides, smoke rolls low, an overturned bus burns, taxis stand abandoned with headlights on, a burst main floods the asphalt so every flame doubles in reflection. Architecture and landmarks stay IDENTICAL.
REFERENCES: the attached photo defines the PROTAGONIST's face and hair. Do not restyle, beautify, slim or age him. Absolute priority.
CAST LOCK: exactly ONE named human exists — the PROTAGONIST, ONLY in the final beat. Everyone else is an anonymous fleeing Japanese crowd — faces blurred, backlit, smoke-obscured or turned away, never a readable second face.
CHARACTER ANCHOR: an ordinary passer-by just crossing the road; CENTER x≈50%, foreground; carried into frame by the stampede; confusion → disbelief → open-throated shouting.
SIGNATURE PAIR (fixed, do not alter): a SHIBA INU riding a full-size TYRANNOSAURUS REX. The shiba sits upright and dead calm at the base of its neck, ears up, eyes forward, cream-and-rust fur rippling. The T-Rex moves with real animal weight — head counterbalancing each stride, tail sweeping, hide scarred. This pair OWNS the opening shot and returns once, out of focus, at the end.
CLOSED ROSTER — EXACTLY 27 ANIMALS, EACH APPEARING EXACTLY ONCE, NEVER TWICE: tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus. Do NOT add or substitute any other species, and never bring one back after its moment.
OPENING LOCK (fixed): the film starts on a SHIBA INU riding a full-size TYRANNOSAURUS REX at FULL SPRINT — already at top speed on the first frame, head down, tail straight out, strides hammering through the flooded crossing, water exploding from each foot. The shiba braces low at the base of its neck, ears flattened, hat strapped tight, pendant flying, eyes forward and utterly calm.
CROWD AUDIO LOCK: a dense continuous wall of JAPANESE voices for the whole shot — men, women and children screaming, shouting warnings, sobbing:「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」. The voices never stop, never turn into English, never resolve into one speaker until the final beat.
COSTUME LOCK (every animal, no exceptions): each wears an EGGPLANT-PATTERNED BUCKET HAT — real cloth printed with purple aubergines, fitted to its head, strap under the chin — and a SHRIMP NECKLACE, a cord carrying one large realistic prawn pendant that swings as it moves. Photoreal, wet, smoke-stained, battered, never cartoon accessories. Every animal in every frame has BOTH.
LOCKS: animals are always CLOSE or EXTREME CLOSE at street level, filling 60-90% of frame as the camera passes; the crowd always flees AWAY from them; the camera keeps travelling forward so the geography reads as one continuous run.

【ONE-SHOT: SHIBUYA — WARTIME ANIMAL PANIC】(~26s · 9:16 · R2V · GLOBAL applied · NO CUTS)
FIRST FRAME: the T-Rex at full sprint, ground-level camera racing alongside its churning legs, flooded asphalt exploding into fire-lit spray, burning Shibuya streaking past.

BEAT 1 (00:00-00:02.0) — SHIBA ON THE SPRINTING T-REX
• CAMERA: ground-skimming sprint alongside the T-Rex at its speed, then a fast CRANE-UP along its flank onto the shiba's face.
• ACTION: the T-Rex tears across the flooded crossing, each stride blasting water into the firelight; the shiba braces low on its neck, hat strapped down, pendant whipping, eyes dead calm.
• AUDIO: two sub-bass footfalls, reptilian breathing, screaming, a car alarm.

BEAT 2 (00:02.0-00:03.6) — INTO THE CROWD
• CAMERA: the lens peels off the T-Rex and DIVES into the crowd, weaving between running bodies.
• ACTION: hundreds of Japanese civilians sprint at and past the camera through smoke and floodwater, a shoulder clipping the lens and spinning the frame.
• AUDIO: a wall of screaming,「危ない！」「早く！早く！」, splashing footfalls, a shorting billboard cracking overhead.

BEAT 3 (00:03.6-00:05.2) — RHINOCEROS + BISON
• CAMERA: the camera whips right and races alongside them, inches off their shoulders.
• ACTION: the rhino and the bison charge as one mass through the burning wreckage, hats soaked and jammed low, pendants swinging, scattering a barricade of bicycles.
• AUDIO: hoof thunder, snorting, metal crumpling, screams rising in pitch.

BEAT 4 (00:05.2-00:07.0) — GORILLA + CHIMPANZEE + ORANGUTAN
• CAMERA: the camera swings up and ORBITS a burning taxi as they take it.
• ACTION: the gorilla hammers both fists through the taxi roof, the chimpanzee screams into the lens with its hat askew, the orangutan swings off a bent pole past the camera, pendants flying.
• AUDIO: metal booming, shrieking chatter, a chest roar, glass bursting,「助けて！」

BEAT 5 (00:07.0-00:08.4) — OSTRICH + PENGUIN
• CAMERA: the camera drops to knee height and tracks with them.
• ACTION: the ostrich sprints past, neck whipping and hat flapping on its strap, the penguin belly-sliding beneath it, pendant dragging a wake through the water.
• AUDIO: clawed footfalls, a hissing screech, a wet slide, sirens.

BEAT 6 (00:08.4-00:10.2) — TIGER + LION ★SPEED RAMP
• CAMERA: the camera arcs low around their leap. SPEED RAMP: 0.3x for 0.8s, then SNAP to 1x — still no cut.
• ACTION: the tiger and the lion launch together over the burning bus in slow motion, every ember, droplet and swinging pendant hanging in the air, then time slams back as they land past the lens.
• AUDIO: the mix drops to a muffled hum, then paw impacts, a double roar, the crowd flooding back.

BEAT 7 (00:10.2-00:11.8) — ELEPHANT + HIPPOPOTAMUS
• CAMERA: the camera pushes through the narrowing gap between them.
• ACTION: the elephant's trunk hurls a road sign over the lens, hat jammed over one eye; beside it the hippo cranks its jaws to full width, pendant swinging under its chin.
• AUDIO: a trumpeting blast, a wet bellow, the sign clanging away, screams.

BEAT 8 (00:11.8-00:13.2) — GIRAFFE + CAMEL
• CAMERA: the camera tilts hard up, whips with the giraffe's head, then falls back down.
• ACTION: the giraffe's head smashes through a burning billboard's lower edge, sparks and panels raining past the lens, the camel shouldering through the taxis below, hats soaked, pendants swinging.
• AUDIO: an electrical crack, panels hitting water, plodding steps, sirens.

BEAT 9 (00:13.2-00:14.6) — CROCODILE + KOMODO DRAGON
• CAMERA: the camera dives to water level and races backward ahead of them.
• ACTION: the crocodile's jaws snap shut on a floating bag and shake it apart, hat riding above its eyes, the komodo dragging itself at the

es.content:
SALIDA: ~26 s · 9:16 vertical · R2V · UN SOLO PLANO SECUENCIA ININTERRUMPIDO. SIN cortes, SIN ediciones, SIN transiciones, SIN fotogramas negros — la cámara nunca deja de moverse. Plano secuencia de desastre al estilo Hollywood: la lente corre, hace whip pans, se zambulle, asciende y orbita a través del caos en un solo vuelo. Dos breves SPEED-RAMPS son la única manipulación del tiempo, y aun así nunca hay corte. NADA de música JAMÁS — solo fuego, sirenas, Foley de animales y una pared de voces japonesas gritando.
ESTILO: cine blockbuster de acción en vivo fotorrealista DE NOCHE DURANTE LA GUERRA. Energía de gimbal, motion blur real, brasas y ceniza en cada haz, anamorphic flare, negros profundos, grano ISO. Luz principal naranja fuego de edificios ardiendo, relleno frío azul de emergencia, resplandor rojo de bengalas, reflectores barriendo el suelo. NO anime, NO CG-cartoon, nunca tierno. Cada criatura tiene peso real — pelaje, piel y músculo, húmedos de hollín y humo.
UBICACIÓN: Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokio, de noche en tiempo de guerra. La mitad de los paneles LED están destrozados y haciendo cortocircuito; el resto sigue parpadeando anuncios sobre la ruina. Los edificios arden a ambos lados, el humo se arrastra bajo, un autobús volcado arde, los taxis están abandonados con las luces encendidas, una tubería principal reventada inunda el asfalto para que cada llama se duplique en el reflejo. La arquitectura y los puntos de referencia se mantienen IDÉNTICOS.
REFERENCIAS: la foto adjunta define el rostro y el cabello del PROTAGONISTA. No lo reestilices, embellezcas, adelgaces ni envejezcas. Prioridad absoluta.
BLOQUEO DE REPARTO: existe exactamente UN humano con nombre — el PROTAGONISTA, SOLO en el beat final. Todos los demás son una multitud japonesa anónima que huye — rostros borrosos, a contraluz, ocultos por el humo o de espaldas, nunca un segundo rostro legible.
ANCLAJE DEL PERSONAJE: un transeúnte común cruzando la calle; CENTRO x≈50%, primer plano; arrastrado al encuadre por la estampida; confusión → incredulidad → gritos a voz en cuello.
PAREJA FIRMA (fija, no alterar): un SHIBA INU montando un TYRANNOSAURUS REX de tamaño real. El shiba va erguido y totalmente sereno en la base del cuello, orejas arriba, mirada al frente, pelaje crema y rojizo ondulando. El T-Rex se mueve con peso animal real — la cabeza contrarrestando cada zancada, la cola barriendo, la piel cicatrizada. Esta pareja SE ADUEÑA del plano inicial y vuelve una vez, desenfocada, al final.
REPARTO CERRADO — EXACTAMENTE 27 ANIMALES, CADA UNO APARECIENDO EXACTAMENTE UNA VEZ, NUNCA DOS: tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus. NO añadas ni sustituyas ninguna otra especie, y nunca la vuelvas a traer después de su momento.
BLOQUEO DE APERTURA (fijo): la película empieza con un SHIBA INU montando un TYRANNOSAURUS REX de tamaño real a TODA VELOCIDAD — ya a máxima velocidad en el primer fotograma, cabeza baja, cola extendida, zancadas martilleando el cruce inundado, agua explotando desde cada pata. El shiba se aferra bajo en la base del cuello, orejas aplastadas, sombrero bien sujeto, colgante volando, mirada al frente y totalmente calmada.
BLOQUEO DE AUDIO DE LA MULTITUD: una densa pared continua de voces JAPONESAS durante todo el plano — hombres, mujeres y niños gritando, dando avisos, sollozando:「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」. Las voces nunca se detienen, nunca pasan al inglés, nunca se resuelven en un solo hablante hasta el beat final.
BLOQUEO DE VESTUARIO (todos los animales, sin excepciones): cada uno lleva un BUCKET HAT CON PATRÓN DE BERENJENA — tela real impresa con berenjenas moradas, ajustado a la cabeza, correa bajo la barbilla — y un COLLAR DE GAMBAS, un cordón con un gran colgante de gamba realista que se balancea al moverse. Fotorrealista, húmedo, manchado de humo, golpeado, nunca accesorios de caricatura. Cada animal en cada fotograma lleva AMBOS.
BLOQUEOS: los animales están siempre CERCA o en PRIMERÍSIMO PRIMER PLANO a nivel de calle, ocupando el 60-90% del encuadre mientras la cámara pasa; la multitud siempre huye LEJOS de ellos; la cámara sigue avanzando para que la geografía se lea como una sola carrera continua.

【PLANO ÚNICO: SHIBUYA — PÁNICO ANIMAL EN TIEMPO DE GUERRA】(~26 s · 9:16 · R2V · GLOBAL aplicado · SIN CORTES)
PRIMER FOTOGRAMA: el T-Rex a toda velocidad, cámara a ras de suelo corriendo junto a sus patas en movimiento, el asfalto inundado explotando en salpicaduras iluminadas por el fuego, Shibuya ardiendo pasando a toda velocidad.

BEAT 1 (00:00-00:02.0) — SHIBA SOBRE EL T-REX EN CARRERA
• CÁMARA: sprint rozando el suelo junto al T-Rex a su misma velocidad, luego un rápido CRANE-UP por su costado hasta el rostro del shiba.
• ACCIÓN: el T-Rex atraviesa a la carrera el cruce inundado, cada zancada lanza agua hacia la luz del fuego; el shiba se aferra bajo en su cuello, sombrero sujeto, colgante azotando, ojos totalmente serenos.
• AUDIO: dos pisadas subgraves, respiración reptiliana, gritos, una alarma de coche.

BEAT 2 (00:02.0-00:03.6) — HACIA LA MULTITUD
• CÁMARA: la lente se desprende del T-Rex y SE ZAMBULLE en la multitud, zigzagueando entre cuerpos en carrera.
• ACCIÓN: cientos de civiles japoneses corren hacia la cámara y la sobrepasan entre humo y agua de inundación, un hombro golpea la lente y hace girar el encuadre.
• AUDIO: una pared de gritos,「危ない！」「早く！早く！」, pisadas salpicando, un cartel haciendo cortocircuito crujiendo arriba.

BEAT 3 (00:03.6-00:05.2) — RHINOCEROS + BISON
• CÁMARA: la cámara hace whip a la derecha y corre junto a ellos, a centímetros de sus hombros.
• ACCIÓN: el rinoceronte y el bisonte cargan como una sola masa a través de los restos en llamas, sombreros empapados y hundidos, colgantes balanceándose, dispersando una barricada de bicicletas.
• AUDIO: trueno de cascos, resoplidos, metal aplastándose, gritos subiendo de tono.

BEAT 4 (00:05.2-00:07.0) — GORILLA + CHIMPANZEE + ORANGUTAN
• CÁMARA: la cámara asciende y ORBITA un taxi en llamas mientras ellos lo toman.
• ACCIÓN: el gorila destroza el techo del taxi con ambos puños, el chimpancé grita a la lente con el sombrero torcido, el orangután se balancea desde un poste doblado pasando junto a la cámara, colgantes volando.
• AUDIO: metal retumbando, parloteo chillón, un rugido de pecho, vidrio estallando,「助けて！」

BEAT 5 (00:07.0-00:08.4) — OSTRICH + PENGUIN
• CÁMARA: la cámara baja a la altura de la rodilla y los sigue.
• ACCIÓN: el avestruz pasa corriendo, cuello azotando y sombrero aleteando en la correa, el pingüino se desliza panza abajo bajo él, el colgante arrastra una estela por el agua.
• AUDIO: pis

fr.content:
OUTPUT : ~26 s · vertical 9:16 · R2V · UN SEUL PLAN SANS INTERRUPTION. AUCUNE coupe, AUCUN montage, AUCUNE transition, AUCUN cadre noir — la caméra ne s’arrête jamais de bouger. Plan-séquence catastrophe à la Hollywood : l’objectif file, fouette, plonge, remonte et orbite à travers le chaos en un seul élan. Deux brefs SPEED-RAMPS sont les seules manipulations du temps, et il n’y a toujours aucune coupe. AUCUNE musique JAMAIS — seulement le feu, les sirènes, le foley animal et un mur de voix japonaises hurlantes.
STYLE : cinéma blockbuster live-action photoréaliste, DE NUIT EN TEMPS DE GUERRE. Énergie de gimbal, vrai motion blur, braises et cendres dans chaque faisceau, flare anamorphique, noirs profonds, grain ISO. Key orange feu venant des bâtiments en flammes, fill bleu froid des secours, lueur rouge des fusées éclairantes, projecteurs balayant le sol. PAS d’anime, PAS de cartoon CG, jamais mignon. Chaque créature a un vrai poids — fourrure, peau et muscles, mouillés de suie et de fumée.
LIEU : Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo, la nuit en temps de guerre. La moitié des panneaux LED sont brisés et en court-circuit, les autres clignotent encore des pubs au-dessus des ruines. Des bâtiments brûlent des deux côtés, la fumée rase le sol, un bus renversé brûle, des taxis sont abandonnés phares allumés, une conduite principale rompue inonde l’asphalte, si bien que chaque flamme se double dans le reflet. L’architecture et les repères restent IDENTIQUES.
RÉFÉRENCES : la photo jointe définit le visage et les cheveux du PROTAGONISTE. Ne pas le re-styliser, l’embellir, l’affiner ni le vieillir. Priorité absolue.
VERROU DU CASTING : exactement UN seul humain nommé existe — le PROTAGONISTE, UNIQUEMENT dans le dernier temps fort. Tous les autres sont une foule japonaise anonyme en fuite — visages floutés, rétroéclairés, masqués par la fumée ou tournés ailleurs, jamais un deuxième visage lisible.
ANCRAGE DU PERSONNAGE : un passant ordinaire qui traverse simplement la route ; CENTRE x≈50 %, premier plan ; emporté dans le cadre par la bousculade ; confusion → incrédulité → cris à pleins poumons.
PAIRE SIGNATURE (fixe, ne pas modifier) : un SHIBA INU chevauchant un TYRANNOSAURUS REX grandeur nature. Le shiba est assis bien droit et d’un calme absolu à la base de son cou, oreilles dressées, regard vers l’avant, fourrure crème et rousse ondulant. Le T-Rex se déplace avec un vrai poids animal — la tête contrebalance chaque foulée, la queue balaie, la peau est scarifiée. Cette paire S’APPROPRIE le plan d’ouverture et revient une fois, floue, à la fin.
ROSTER FERMÉ — EXACTEMENT 27 ANIMAUX, CHACUN APPARAISSANT EXACTEMENT UNE FOIS, JAMAIS DEUX FOIS : tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus. N’ajoutez ni ne remplacez aucune autre espèce, et ne la faites jamais revenir après son moment.
VERRO D’OUVERTURE (fixe) : le film commence sur un SHIBA INU chevauchant un TYRANNOSAURUS REX grandeur nature au PLEIN SPRINT — déjà à vitesse maximale dès la première image, tête baissée, queue tendue, foulées martelant le passage inondé, l’eau explosant à chaque pas. Le shiba se cale bas à la base du cou, oreilles plaquées, chapeau bien sanglé, pendentif au vent, regard droit devant et totalement calme.
VERRO AUDIO DE FOULE : un mur dense et continu de voix JAPOANAISES pendant tout le plan — hommes, femmes et enfants qui hurlent, lancent des avertissements, sanglotent :「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」. Les voix ne s’arrêtent jamais, ne passent jamais à l’anglais, ne se résolvent jamais en un seul locuteur avant le dernier temps fort.
VERRO COSTUME (chaque animal, sans exception) : chacun porte un BUCKET HAT À MOTIF D’AUBERGINE — vrai tissu imprimé d’aubergines violettes, ajusté à la tête, sangle sous le menton — et un COLLIER DE CREVETTE, un cordon portant un gros pendentif de crevette réaliste qui se balance en mouvement. Photoréaliste, mouillé, taché de fumée, abîmé, jamais d’accessoires cartoon. Chaque animal dans chaque image a LES DEUX.
VERROUS : les animaux sont toujours PROCHES ou EN TRÈS GROS PLAN au niveau de la rue, occupant 60 à 90 % du cadre au passage de la caméra ; la foule fuit toujours À L’OPPOSÉ d’eux ; la caméra continue d’avancer pour que la géographie se lise comme une seule course continue.

【PLAN UNIQUE : SHIBUYA — PANIQUE ANIMALE EN TEMPS DE GUERRE】(~26 s · 9:16 · R2V · GLOBAL appliqué · AUCUNE COUPE)
PREMIÈRE IMAGE : le T-Rex au sprint maximal, caméra au ras du sol courant à côté de ses jambes en mouvement, l’asphalte inondé explosant en gerbes éclairées par le feu, Shibuya en flammes défilant à toute vitesse.

BEAT 1 (00:00-00:02.0) — SHIBA SUR LE T-REX AU SPRINT
• CAMÉRA : sprint rasant le sol à côté du T-Rex à sa vitesse, puis CRANE-UP rapide le long de son flanc jusqu’au visage du shiba.
• ACTION : le T-Rex déchire le passage inondé, chaque foulée projetant l’eau dans la lumière des flammes ; le shiba se cale bas sur son cou, chapeau sanglé, pendentif fouettant l’air, regard d’un calme absolu.
• AUDIO : deux impacts de pas sub-bass, respiration reptilienne, cris, alarme de voiture.

BEAT 2 (00:02.0-00:03.6) — DANS LA FOULE
• CAMÉRA : l’objectif se détache du T-Rex et PLONGE dans la foule, se faufilant entre les corps en course.
• ACTION : des centaines de civils japonais sprintent vers la caméra et la dépassent à travers la fumée et l’eau de crue, une épaule heurte l’objectif et fait tourner l’image.
• AUDIO : un mur de cris,「危ない！」「早く！早く！」, pas éclaboussés, un panneau en court-circuit qui craque au-dessus.

BEAT 3 (00:03.6-00:05.2) — RHINOCÉROS + BISON
• CAMÉRA : la caméra fouette à droite et court à leurs côtés, à quelques centimètres de leurs épaules.
• ACTION : le rhino et le bison chargent comme une seule masse à travers les décombres en feu, chapeaux trempés et enfoncés bas, pendentifs balançant, dispersant une barricade de vélos.
• AUDIO : tonnerre de sabots, reniflements, métal qui se froisse, cris qui montent dans les aigus.

BEAT 4 (00:05.2-00:07.0) — GORILLE + CHIMPANZÉ + ORANG-OUTAN
• CAMÉRA : la caméra monte et ORBITE autour d’un taxi en feu pendant qu’ils le prennent.
• ACTION : le gorille enfonce ses deux poings à travers le toit du taxi, le chimpanzé hurle dans l’objectif avec son chapeau de travers, l’orang-outan se balance depuis un poteau tordu en passant devant la caméra, pendentifs au vent.
• AUDIO : métal qui résonne, bavardage strident, rugissement de poitrine, verre qui éclate,「助けて！」

BEAT 5 (00:07.0-00:08.4) — AUTRUCHE + PINGOUIN
• CAMÉRA : la caméra descend à hauteur de genou et les suit.
• ACTION : l’autruche file en courant, cou tendu et chapeau battant sur sa sangle

OUTPUT: ~26초 · 9:16 세로 · R2V · 단 하나의 끊기지 않는 샷. 컷 없음, 편집 없음, 전환 없음, 검은 프레임 없음 — 카메라는 절대 멈추지 않는다. 할리우드 재난 원테이크: 렌즈가 혼돈 속을 질주하고, 휘두르고, 급강하하고, 상승하고, 궤도를 그리며 한 번의 비행으로 통과한다. 두 번의 짧은 SPEED-RAMP만이 유일한 시간 조작이며, 그럼에도 절대 컷하지 않는다. 음악은 절대 없음 — 오직 불길, 사이렌, 동물 Foley, 그리고 비명을 지르는 일본어 목소리의 벽만 존재한다.  
STYLE: 전쟁 중 밤의 포토리얼 라이브액션 블록버스터 시네마. 짐벌 같은 에너지, 실제 모션 블러, 모든 광선 속의 불씨와 재, 아나모픽 플레어, 깊은 블랙, ISO 그레인. 타오르는 건물에서 오는 불꽃 주황색 키 라이트, 차가운 파란색 비상 조명, 붉은 플레어 글로우, 지면을 훑는 서치라이트. 애니메이션 아님, CG 카툰 아님, 절대 귀엽게 보이지 않음. 모든 생물은 실제 무게감을 지닌다 — 털, 가죽, 근육, 연기와 그을음으로 젖어 있음.  
LOCATION: 전시 중 밤의 도쿄 시부야 스크램블 교차로. LED 전광판 절반은 산산조각 나고 합선으로 스파크가 튀며, 나머지는 폐허 위로 여전히 광고를 깜빡인다. 양쪽 건물은 불타고, 연기는 낮게 깔리며, 전복된 버스가 타고 있고, 택시들은 헤드라이트를 켠 채 버려져 있으며, 파열된 상수관이 아스팔트를 물로 뒤덮어 모든 불꽃이 반사 속에서 두 배로 보인다. 건축물과 랜드마크는 완전히 동일하게 유지된다.  
REFERENCES: 첨부된 사진이 PROTAGONIST의 얼굴과 머리카락을 정의한다. 스타일을 바꾸거나, 미화하거나, 날씬하게 만들거나, 나이 들어 보이게 하지 말 것. 절대 우선순위.  
CAST LOCK: 이름이 있는 인간은 정확히 한 명만 존재한다 — PROTAGONIST, 오직 마지막 비트에만 등장. 그 외 모두는 정체불명의 도망치는 일본인 군중 — 얼굴은 흐리게, 역광으로, 연기에 가리거나 뒤돌아선 상태이며, 읽을 수 있는 두 번째 얼굴은 절대 없음.  
CHARACTER ANCHOR: 막 길을 건너던 평범한 행인; CENTER x≈50%, 전경; 군중의 쇄도에 휩쓸려 프레임 안으로 들어옴; 혼란 → 불신 → 목이 터져라 외침.  
SIGNATURE PAIR (fixed, do not alter): 풀사이즈 TYRANNOSAURUS REX를 타고 있는 SHIBA INU. 시바는 목의 기저부에 꼿꼿이 앉아 완전히 침착하며, 귀는 세우고 시선은 정면, 크림색과 적갈색 털이 바람에 물결친다. T-Rex는 실제 동물의 무게감으로 움직인다 — 머리는 각 보폭마다 균형을 잡고, 꼬리는 휘저으며, 가죽에는 흉터가 있다. 이 페어는 오프닝 샷을 장악하고, 마지막에 한 번만 초점이 흐린 채 다시 등장한다.  
CLOSED ROSTER — 정확히 27마리의 동물만, 각 동물은 정확히 한 번만 등장하고 절대 두 번 나오지 않음: tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus. 다른 종을 추가하거나 대체하지 말 것, 그리고 한 번 등장한 뒤 다시 불러오지 말 것.  
OPENING LOCK (fixed): 영화는 SHIBA INU가 풀사이즈 TYRANNOSAURUS REX를 타고 FULL SPRINT 중인 장면으로 시작한다 — 첫 프레임부터 이미 최고 속도, 머리는 숙이고 꼬리는 곧게 뻗은 채, 보폭이 물에 잠긴 교차로를 강타하며 달리고, 발마다 물이 폭발한다. 시바는 목 아래쪽에 낮게 몸을 고정하고, 귀는 눕혀져 있으며, 모자는 단단히 묶여 있고, 펜던트는 날아가며, 시선은 정면을 향한 채 완전히 침착하다.  
CROWD AUDIO LOCK: 전체 샷 동안 일본어 목소리의 밀도 높은 연속적인 벽 — 남자, 여자, 아이들이 비명을 지르고, 경고를 외치고, 흐느낀다:「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」. 목소리는 절대 멈추지 않고, 영어로 바뀌지 않으며, 마지막 비트 전까지 한 명의 화자로 정리되지 않는다.  
COSTUME LOCK (every animal, no exceptions): 각 동물은 모두 EGGPLANT-PATTERNED BUCKET HAT — 보라색 가지무늬가 인쇄된 실제 천, 머리에 맞게 착용, 턱 아래 스트랩 — 그리고 SHRIMP NECKLACE, 움직일 때 흔들리는 큰 사실적인 새우 펜던트 하나가 달린 끈을 착용한다. 포토리얼, 젖어 있고, 연기와 그을음에 얼룩지고, 낡아 보이며, 절대 만화 같은 액세서리가 아니다. 모든 프레임의 모든 동물은 둘 다 착용한다.  
LOCKS: 동물들은 항상 거리 수준에서 CLOSE 또는 EXTREME CLOSE로, 카메라가 지나갈 때 프레임의 60~90%를 채운다; 군중은 항상 그들로부터 멀어져 도망친다; 카메라는 계속 전진하므로 지리적 구성이 하나의 연속된 질주처럼 읽힌다.

【ONE-SHOT: SHIBUYA — WARTIME ANIMAL PANIC】(~26초 · 9:16 · R2V · GLOBAL 적용 · NO CUTS)  
FIRST FRAME: T-Rex가 전속력으로 질주 중이며, 지면 높이의 카메라가 그 요동치는 다리 옆을 함께 달리고, 물에 잠긴 아스팔트가 불빛을 머금은 물보라로 폭발하며, 불타는 시부야가 스쳐 지나간다.

BEAT 1 (00:00-00:02.0) — 질주하는 T-REX 위의 시바  
• CAMERA: T-Rex의 속도에 맞춰 지면을 스치듯 질주하다가, 그 옆구리를 따라 빠르게 CRANE-UP하여 시바의 얼굴로 올라간다.  
• ACTION: T-Rex가 물에 잠긴 교차로를 가르며 질주하고, 각 보폭마다 물이 불빛 속으로 폭발한다; 시바는 목 아래 낮게 버티며 모자를 단단히 고정하고, 펜던트는 휘날리며, 눈은 완전히 침착하다.  
• AUDIO: 저음역 발걸음 두 번, 파충류의 호흡, 비명, 자동차 경보음.

BEAT 2 (00:02.0-00:03.6) — 군중 속으로  
• CAMERA: 렌즈가 T-Rex에서 떨어져 나와 군중 속으로 DIVES, 달리는 몸들 사이를 누비며 들어간다.  
• ACTION: 수백 명의 일본 시민들이 연기와 범람한 물을 가르며 카메라를 향해, 그리고 카메라를 지나쳐 질주하고, 한 어깨가 렌즈를 스치며 프레임을 회전시킨다.  
• AUDIO: 비명의 벽,「危ない！」「早く！早く！」, 물 튀기는 발걸음, 머리 위에서 합선된 전광판이 금 가는 소리.

BEAT 3 (00:03.6-00:05.2) — 코뿔소 + 들소  
• CAMERA: 카메라가 오른쪽으로 휘돌아 그들과 나란히

OUTPUT: ~26s · vertical 9:16 · R2V · UM ÚNICO PLANO-SEQUÊNCIA ININTERRUPTO. SEM cortes, SEM edições, SEM transições, SEM quadros pretos — a câmera nunca para de se mover. Plano-sequência de desastre hollywoodiano: a lente corre, faz whip, mergulha, sobe e orbita pelo caos em um único voo. Dois breves SPEED-RAMPS são a única manipulação de tempo, e ainda assim nunca há corte. SEM música NUNCA — apenas fogo, sirenes, Foley de animais e uma parede de vozes japonesas gritando.
STYLE: cinema blockbuster live-action fotorrealista À NOITE DURANTE A GUERRA. Energia de gimbal, motion blur real, brasas e cinzas em cada feixe, anamorphic flare, pretos profundos, granulação ISO. Luz principal laranja-fogo vinda de prédios em chamas, preenchimento frio azul de emergência, brilho vermelho de sinalizadores, holofotes varrendo o chão. NÃO anime, NÃO cartoon em CG, nunca fofo. Cada criatura tem peso real — pelo, couro e músculo, úmidos de fuligem e fumaça.
LOCATION: Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tóquio, à noite em tempo de guerra. Metade dos painéis de LED está quebrada e em curto, o restante ainda pisca anúncios sobre a ruína. Prédios queimam dos dois lados, a fumaça baixa se arrasta, um ônibus tombado pega fogo, táxis abandonados ficam com os faróis acesos, uma tubulação estourada inunda o asfalto para que cada chama se duplique no reflexo. A arquitetura e os marcos permanecem IDÊNTICOS.
REFERENCES: a foto anexada define o rosto e o cabelo do PROTAGONISTA. Não estilize, embeleze, afine nem envelheça ele. Prioridade absoluta.
CAST LOCK: existe exatamente UM humano nomeado — o PROTAGONISTA, SOMENTE no beat final. Todos os demais são uma multidão japonesa anônima em fuga — rostos borrados, contra-luz, obscurecidos pela fumaça ou virados para longe, nunca um segundo rosto legível.
CHARACTER ANCHOR: um transeunte comum atravessando a rua; CENTRO x≈50%, primeiro plano; carregado para dentro do quadro pela debandada; confusão → descrença → gritos de garganta aberta.
SIGNATURE PAIR (fixed, do not alter): a SHIBA INU riding a full-size TYRANNOSAURUS REX. The shiba sits upright and dead calm at the base of its neck, ears up, eyes forward, cream-and-rust fur rippling. The T-Rex moves with real animal weight — head counterbalancing each stride, tail sweeping, hide scarred. This pair OWNS the opening shot and returns once, out of focus, at the end.
CLOSED ROSTER — EXACTLY 27 ANIMALS, EACH APPEARING EXACTLY ONCE, NEVER TWICE: tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus. Do NOT add or substitute any other species, and never bring one back after its moment.
OPENING LOCK (fixed): the film starts on a SHIBA INU riding a full-size TYRANNOSAURUS REX at FULL SPRINT — already at top speed on the first frame, head down, tail straight out, strides hammering through the flooded crossing, water exploding from each foot. The shiba braces low at the base of its neck, ears flattened, hat strapped tight, pendant flying, eyes forward and utterly calm.
CROWD AUDIO LOCK: a dense continuous wall of JAPANESE voices for the whole shot — men, women and children screaming, shouting warnings, sobbing:「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」. The voices never stop, never turn into English, never resolve into one speaker until the final beat.
COSTUME LOCK (every animal, no exceptions): each wears an EGGPLANT-PATTERNED BUCKET HAT — real cloth printed with purple aubergines, fitted to its head, strap under the chin — and a SHRIMP NECKLACE, a cord carrying one large realistic prawn pendant that swings as it moves. Photoreal, wet, smoke-stained, battered, never cartoon accessories. Every animal in every frame has BOTH.
LOCKS: animals are always CLOSE or EXTREME CLOSE at street level, filling 60-90% of frame as the camera passes; the crowd always flees AWAY from them; the camera keeps travelling forward so the geography reads as one continuous run.

【ONE-SHOT: SHIBUYA — WARTIME ANIMAL PANIC】(~26s · 9:16 · R2V · GLOBAL applied · NO CUTS)
FIRST FRAME: the T-Rex at full sprint, ground-level camera racing alongside its churning legs, flooded asphalt exploding into fire-lit spray, burning Shibuya streaking past.

BEAT 1 (00:00-00:02.0) — SHIBA ON THE SPRINTING T-REX
• CAMERA: ground-skimming sprint alongside the T-Rex at its speed, then a fast CRANE-UP along its flank onto the shiba's face.
• ACTION: the T-Rex tears across the flooded crossing, each stride blasting water into the firelight; the shiba braces low on its neck, hat strapped down, pendant whipping, eyes dead calm.
• AUDIO: two sub-bass footfalls, reptilian breathing, screaming, a car alarm.

BEAT 2 (00:02.0-00:03.6) — INTO THE CROWD
• CAMERA: the lens peels off the T-Rex and DIVES into the crowd, weaving between running bodies.
• ACTION: hundreds of Japanese civilians sprint at and past the camera through smoke and floodwater, a shoulder clipping the lens and spinning the frame.
• AUDIO: a wall of screaming,「危ない！」「早く！早く！」, splashing footfalls, a shorting billboard cracking overhead.

BEAT 3 (00:03.6-00:05.2) — RHINOCEROS + BISON
• CAMERA: the camera whips right and races alongside them, inches off their shoulders.
• ACTION: the rhino and the bison charge as one mass through the burning wreckage, hats soaked and jammed low, pendants swinging, scattering a barricade of bicycles.
• AUDIO: hoof thunder, snorting, metal crumpling, screams rising in pitch.

BEAT 4 (00:05.2-00:07.0) — GORILLA + CHIMPANZEE + ORANGUTAN
• CAMERA: the camera swings up and ORBITS a burning taxi as they take it.
• ACTION: the gorilla hammers both fists through the taxi roof, the chimpanzee screams into the lens with its hat askew, the orangutan swings off a bent pole past the camera, pendants flying.
• AUDIO: metal booming, shrieking chatter, a chest roar, glass bursting,「助けて！」

BEAT 5 (00:07.0-00:08.4) — OSTRICH + PENGUIN
• CAMERA: the camera drops to knee height and tracks with them.
• ACTION: the ostrich sprints past, neck whipping and hat flapping on its strap, the penguin belly-sliding beneath it, pendant dragging a wake through the water.
• AUDIO: clawed footfalls, a hissing screech, a wet slide, sirens.

BEAT 6 (00:08.4-00:10.2) — TIGER + LION ★SPEED RAMP
• CAMERA: the camera arcs low around their leap. SPEED RAMP: 0.3x for 0.8s, then SNAP to 1x — still no cut.
• ACTION: the tiger and the lion launch together over the burning bus in slow motion, every ember, droplet and swinging pendant hanging in the air, then time slams back as they land past the lens.

输出：约26秒 · 9:16 竖屏 · R2V · 单一连续不间断长镜头。不要切镜头、不要剪辑、不要转场、不要黑场——镜头永不停下移动。好莱坞灾难片一镜到底：镜头在混乱中疾驰、甩动、俯冲、上升、环绕，一气呵成。只有两次短暂的 SPEED-RAMP 作为唯一的时间操控，而且依然绝不切镜。绝对不要音乐——只有火焰、警笛、动物 Foley，以及一整面墙的日本人尖叫声。  
风格：夜晚战时的写实真人大片电影感。稳定器能量、真实运动模糊、每一道光束里都有火星与灰烬、变形宽银幕镜头光晕、深黑位、ISO 颗粒。燃烧建筑提供火橙色主光，冷蓝色应急补光，红色信号弹辉光，探照灯扫过地面。不是动漫，不是 CG 卡通，绝不卖萌。每个生物都具有真实重量——毛发、皮肤和肌肉都沾着烟灰与污渍。  
地点：东京涩谷十字路口，战时夜晚。半数 LED 广告牌破碎并短路，其余仍在废墟上方闪烁广告。两侧建筑燃烧，浓烟低低翻滚，一辆翻倒的公交车在燃烧，出租车无人弃置、车灯仍亮，一处主水管爆裂让沥青路面被水淹没，使每一团火焰都在倒影中翻倍。建筑与地标必须保持完全一致。  
参考：附图定义主角的脸和头发。不要重塑、不要美化、不要瘦脸、不要让他显老。绝对优先。  
演员锁定：全片恰好只有一位有名有姓的人类——主角，而且只在最后一个节拍出现。其他所有人都是匿名逃难的日本人群——脸部模糊、逆光、被烟遮挡或背对镜头，绝不出现第二张可辨识的人脸。  
角色锚点：一个刚过马路的普通路人；位于画面中央 x≈50%，前景；被人潮裹挟进画面；情绪从困惑 → 难以置信 → 张口尖叫。  
标志性搭档（固定，不得更改）：一只骑在全尺寸霸王龙上的柴犬。柴犬端坐在霸王龙颈部根部，神情死一般平静，耳朵竖起，目视前方，奶油色与赤褐色的毛发随风翻动。霸王龙以真实动物重量移动——头部随每一步摆动保持平衡，尾巴扫动，皮肤带伤痕。这个组合占据开场镜头，并在结尾以虚焦形式再次出现一次。  
封闭名单——恰好 27 种动物，每种只出现一次，绝不重复：tyrannosaurus, shiba inu, rhinoceros, bison, gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan, ostrich, penguin, tiger, lion, elephant, hippopotamus, giraffe, camel, crocodile, komodo dragon, polar bear, panda, steller sea lion, fur seal, cow, pig, horse, reindeer, kangaroo, pegasus。不要添加或替换任何其他物种，也不要在它们出现过后再让它们回归。  
开场锁定（固定）：影片从一只骑在全尺寸霸王龙上的柴犬开始，霸王龙处于全速冲刺——第一帧就已经是最高速度，头部低伏，尾巴直伸，步伐轰击着被淹没的十字路口，每一步都炸起水花。柴犬低低地稳住在颈根部，耳朵压平，帽子系紧，吊坠飞扬，目视前方，镇定到极致。  
人群音频锁定：整个镜头都要有一堵密集、持续不断的日本语人声墙——男人、女人和孩子都在尖叫、呼喊警告、哭泣：「逃げろ！」「危ない！」「うわあああ！」「助けて！」「早く！早く！」。这些声音永不停止，永不变成英语，直到最后一个节拍才不会收束成单一说话者。  
服装锁定（每只动物，无一例外）：每只都戴着一顶茄子图案的渔夫帽——真实布料印着紫色茄子，贴合头部，带子系在下巴下——以及一条虾项链，一根绳子挂着一个大型逼真的虾吊坠，移动时会摆动。写实、潮湿、沾着烟渍、破旧，绝不是卡通配饰。每一帧里的每只动物都必须同时拥有这两样。  
锁定规则：动物始终在街面高度以近景或超近景出现，镜头经过时占据画面 60–90%；人群始终朝远离它们的方向逃跑；镜头持续向前移动，因此地理空间读起来像一段连续奔跑。
